[attribute-journal-id]
=== `@journal-id` Journal Identifier of a Related Article

Identifier for the journal that contains the related article.

#### Usage/Remarks
The <<attribute-journal-id,`@journal-id`>> attribute can be used, along with the <<attribute-vol,`@vol`>>, <<attribute-issue,`@issue`>>, and <<attribute-page,`@page`>> attributes, to provide the metadata for the related journal article.

#### OPTIONAL on element:  <<element-related-article,`<related-article>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| Text, numbers, or special characters| A journal abbreviation or other journal identifier.
| Restriction| This is an optional attribute; there is no default.
|===
